lithos_version: lithos 0.5.0 @ a4d2d62; every error envelope below probed against a live Lithos (MCP serverInfo 3.2.0, 2026-10-04) except where observed_divergences says otherwise

canonical.reason: superseded by the new ingest path

request.notes: Applies ONLY to an `open` task and answers the SAME `task_not_found` code for a missing task and for a task that is not open, exactly as complete does. Releases every claim on the task. Does NOT cascade to children. `reason` is optional and reaches the log and the `task.cancelled` event payload ONLY — it is not stored on the task row (ROADMAP ledger #6), which is why the cancel form labels it that way. The id is resolved from a full id OR an unambiguous prefix of at least SIX characters: a shorter one is `invalid_input` and a prefix matching more than one task is `ambiguous_id_prefix`, whose `candidates` are `{id, title}` RECORDS (capped upstream — the message says "2 or more matches" rather than a count), not id strings. Lens always sends a full id for this tool (the funnel acts on a task it has just read), so neither refusal is on a Lens request; both are vendored because the mapper must still answer them.

errors.message: Task influx-backfill not found or already closed
task_id 'infl' is too short: pass the full task id or a prefix of at least 6 characters.
Task id prefix '506155' (task_id) is ambiguous: 2 or more matches. Retry with a longer prefix or a full id from candidates.

observed_divergences: The payload says nothing about consequences: the dependents a cancel strands (`blocker_unsatisfiable`), the claims it released and the gate waiters it makes unsatisfiable are all absent, so Lens states them from its own bounded downstream walk BEFORE the call (T3 D9). The `task_not_found` message is the probed one and is worded differently from complete's ("not found or already closed", and it does not quote the id) — same code, two texts, which is why Lens matches on the code and never on the text. The success payload is transcribed from the documented return ("Dict with success, updated_at, and the resolved task_id + title"): it cannot be probed without cancelling a real task.
